Dear Sir/Madam, 
Subject: Audio recording of earnings call of the Company for the quarter ended 
June 30, 2026 
This is further to our letter dated July 7, 2026 and July 15, 2026, we wish to inform 
you that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Company had hosted an 
earnings conference call with investor(s) and analyst(s) on Wednesday,          
July 15, 2026, to discuss the financial performance of the Company for the 
quarter ended   June 30, 2026.
